Definition
[tangent cone and support function] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0061, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0062 1. ch10:10.38,ch10:10.44–10.47\group Convex geometry

The tangent cone at a boundary point is the intersection of all containing closed half-spaces through that point. A support function at $V$ is a unit linear functional $\ell $ with $\ell (X)\le \ell (V)$ on the convex set.
